item.title: Femke Kok makes history with Olympic 500m gold in record time
item.description: Femke Kok has become the first Dutch female speed skater to win Olympic gold in the 500 meters.

item.title: 7 arrested in Arnhem for public violence against climate protesters
item.description: Seven people were arrested Sunday after a climate demonstration near the Blauwe Golven in Arnhem was disrupted, the police confirmed. The suspects face charges of public violence.

item.title: Some 575 flights cancelled, delayed at Schiphol amid snow; 50 more affected tomorrow
item.description: Roughly half of all flights in and out of Schiphol Airport on Sunday faced either cancellation or delay, with several centimeters of snow predicted over the course of the evening.
